mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_hour_batch (user_id, total, remaining, source, order_id, expire_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{total}, #{remaining}, COALESCE(#{source},'recharge'), #{orderId}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_hour_batch WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remaining > 0 AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) ORDER BY (expire_at IS NULL), expire_at, id
SELECT MIN(expire_at) FROM course_hour_batch WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remaining > 0 AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE course_hour_batch SET remaining = remaining - #{qty} WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining >= #{qty}
UPDATE course_hour_batch SET remaining = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining > 0
